usedFor: Wati replies such as “When a recipient replies to a sent message” can change a deal in Freshsales Classic.

bestTemplate.name: “When a recipient replies to a sent message” in Wati, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A reply is a buying signal, and the action can move the deal's stage, amount or probability.

watchOut: “Update Deal” needs a deal ID or name, so the Wati event must pass one of them.
